blocks.text: WUHAN–Polish 16th seed Maja Chwalinska overcame an injured Iga Swiatek to reach the first WTA 1000 final of her career, handing her childhood friend and compatriot a 7-5, 6-1 defeat at the Wuhan Open on Saturday. Chwalinska will next face world number 170 Sonay Kartal, who beat Jelena Ostapenko, 7-6 (11/9), 7-6 (7-5) in the other semifinal match.
